title: GrainElectricalCheckRequest
description: RepairOS -> Grain: POST /projects/{id}/electrical/check {readings: [...]}, <= 200. The check is stateless: the meter wizard sends every reading so far each time (H4). Each reading is exactly one of {net, volts}, {net, pins: [a, b], continuity}, {net, pins: [a, b], ohms}. Pins use net naming REF.PIN (e.g. J1.1), which is what Grain checks against, not harness end names. Pinned against the private recorded Grain fixtures (private/grain/observed/), plus target fields marked x-target. GET /call/schema requires only `net`; the one-of rule is RepairOS's, so we never send a reading Grain can only half-judge. Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.

net.description: A net name from GET /electrical nets[].name.

id.description: Target T2: our MeterReading.reading_id, echoed on the row.
